Finish the mushrooms: Stir and fry for 2 to 3 minutes more, until golden all over and their liquid has gone. Stir in the dried herbs for the last 30 seconds, until they smell fragrant.
Finish the mushrooms: Stir and fry for 2 to 3 minutes more, until golden all over, then lift them on to a plate.

Mix the salad: Add the potatoes, chickpeas, tomatoes and spring onions to the bowl and turn them gently until coated. Leave for 5 minutes to soak up the dressing.
Mix the salad: Add the rice, beans, sweetcorn, pepper and onion to the bowl and stir gently until everything is coated in the dressing.
Mix the salad: Add the rice, peas, tomatoes and cucumber to the rest of the dressing and toss gently until coated. Leave it for 10 minutes so the rice soaks up the dressing.
Mix the salad: Add the tuna and the rest of the dressing to the potatoes and turn everything gently until coated.
Mix the salad: Cut the cucumber into cubes about 1 cm across and halve the cherry tomatoes. Add them to the bowl and turn everything over gently until glossy with the dressing.

Mix the salad: Halve the cherry tomatoes and rinse the spinach unless the bag says it is ready washed. Add them to the pasta with the chicken, peppers and any juices from the tray, and turn everything over gently.
Mix the salad: Put the chickpeas, cucumber and tomatoes in a large bowl, pour over most of the dressing and toss gently.
Mix the salad: Rinse the spinach unless the bag says it is ready washed. Add the pasta, peas and spinach to the dressing and stir, then fold in the salmon gently.
Mix the salad: Tip the hot broccoli, chickpeas and almonds into the bowl, add the onion and toss gently until everything is coated in the dressing.
Mix the salad: Tip the pasta and sweetcorn into the bowl. Add the mayonnaise and a little black pepper and stir gently until coated, without mashing the tuna.

Mix the sauce: Meanwhile, stir the rest of the soy sauce and garlic purée with the honey, chilli powder and tomato purée in a cup with 2 tablespoons of water.
Mix the sauce: Meanwhile, stir the rest of the soy sauce and garlic purée with the honey, chilli powder, black pepper and 2 tablespoons of water in a cup.
Mix the sauce: Meanwhile, stir the soy sauce, sweet chilli sauce, chilli powder, plenty of black pepper and 3 tablespoons of water together in a cup.

Mix the sauce: Stir the peanut butter, half the soy sauce, half the chilli powder, the honey, the lemon juice and 3 tablespoons of hot water from the kettle together in a bowl until smooth and glossy.
Mix the sauce: Stir the soy sauce, honey and garlic purée together in a cup.
Mix the sauce: Stir the soy sauce, honey, lemon juice and chilli powder together in a cup.
Mix the sauce: Stir the tomato purée, honey, the rest of the soy sauce, the lemon juice and 4 tablespoons of water together in a jug until smooth.
Mix the sauce: While the rice cooks, stir the sweet chilli sauce and lemon juice together in a cup with 4 tbsp water.
Mix the spice oil: In a large bowl, mix the oil with the garlic purée, paprika, oregano, the salt and a good grind of black pepper.
Mix the spiced yogurt: Stir the yogurt, cumin, chilli powder, oregano, garlic purée, half the salt and half the lemon juice together until smooth.

Mix the vegetables: Put the peppers, onion and chickpeas in a large roasting tin. Add the rest of the oil and paprika, the cumin, garlic purée and a good grind of black pepper, and toss with a spoon until everything is coated.
Mix the yogurt: Stir the rest of the lemon juice into the yogurt in a small bowl.
Mix together: Drain the pasta, keeping a cup of its water. Stir the pasta into the sauce, loosening it with a splash of the pasta water if it is too thick.
